changelog.zh-TW: v0.0.4.9：天氣詳情新增未來24小時降雨預報；新增 MotoGP 風格的輪胎選擇 / 車輛設定 / 駕駛方式策略卡（已摺疊到

changelog.en:
v0.0.4.9: Weather details now show the next 24h rain forecast. Added a MotoGP-style tire / bike setup / riding style strategy card (collapsed under 'Advanced tips' so it doesn't interfere with reading the weather details first). When a saved track is replayed on the Map TAB, playback controls are now available: 1x / 2x / 4x / 8x speed, drag bar scrubbing, and the star marker bubble shows the current speed and lean angle.
Fix: v0.0.4.8 clients were reporting 'already up to date' because the previously derived versionCode already matched the new release. The update check now additionally compares the semantic versionName.
